description: Returns clean forensic result JSON by job_uid — file names, grades (A–F), detection counts, and analysis asset IDs (face overlays, ELA maps, etc.). Each file also carries `summary_text` (a plain sentence saying why each grade is what it is — quote it to the user as is) and `explanation` (which category set each grade and what fired there). The job_uid is returned by snapwonders_analyse_job_start and snapwonders_analyse_job_results. Requires X-Api-Key header.

job_uid.description: The job_uid returned by snapwonders_analyse_job_start or snapwonders_analyse_job_results
